title: How B-2 Pilots Go to the Bathroom on a 44-Hour Mission
asof: Figures from the 2001 and 2025 missions · full video on the channel

shots.s: Forty-four hours in a bomber. Where do you go?
In 2001, a B-2 crew flew forty-four point three hours nonstop.
The air up there is so dry, pilots drink constantly.
The jet has one small chemical toilet.
It couldn't hold forty-four hours' worth.
So the crew used piddle packs.
Bags with a powder that turns urine into gel.
The pilot said they filled about two an hour.
Then they worked out how many pounds they'd have to unload.
No shower. No change of clothes.
Could you last forty-four hours like that?
